notes.title: Yoram Feature improvement & bug fixes
notes.notes: [h3][b]Feature Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Added highlight functionality for some selectable options.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the notebook and settings screens overlapped.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where unintended scripts were displayed in the log screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the cancel button and the game menu button overlapped in the log screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the UI would unexpectedly disappear in certain situations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where unintended UI elements would appear in certain situations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the question prompt did not appear during arguments after saving and loading the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where text was not displayed correctly after changing the resolution.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Team Yoram will continue to do our best. Thank you.[/b][/p]

notes.title: Yoram Bug Fixes and Feature Improvements
notes.notes: [h2][b]Feature Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Progress guidance is now displayed during situations that require specific actions.[/p][/*][*][p]Added key binding to allow advancing tutorial and TIP messages with the Enter key.[/p][/*][*][p]Pressing ESC in the log now only closes the log instead of opening the settings menu.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now scroll through text using the Z key and mouse wheel.[/p][/*][*][p]Shortcut key info (F) is now displayed on the diary (notebook) ribbon bookmark.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where pressing ESC during an argument would close the notebook.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some event popups appeared behind characters.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some UI elements were broken in the settings menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where font size changes in the settings were not applied.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where game setting values were not properly saved.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Localization Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p](Korean) Fixed punctuation marks such as , . ! ? breaking in some sections.[/p][/*][*][p](English, Japanese) Fixed an issue where some affinity increase messages were shown in Korean.[/p][/*][*][p](English, Japanese) Fixed an issue where the “cannot move” message was displayed in Korean.[/p][/*][*][p](Japanese) Fixed additional broken UI elements in the settings menu.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Known but Unresolved Issue[/b][/h3][list][*][p]When the diary is opened during a debate, clicking on another bookmark triggers unintended behavior.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We will continue to bring you ongoing feature improvements and bug fixes![/p]

notes.title: Yoram Demo Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.notes: [h3][b]Game Settings[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the game’s text setting values were not being saved.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the skip mode reset did not function properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where category text would not update when the language or font size was changed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where font size changes in the settings were not applied in real time.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the [b]UISetting Preview Printer[/b] feature, allowing users to preview changes in advance.[/p][/*][*][p]※ Saving sound settings will be supported starting from the next patch.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]UI/UX[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where mouse hover did not work in the Free Movement window.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where text was cut off or languages were hidden in some UI elements during conversations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some of Dorothy’s lines were incorrectly shown as spoken by Irene.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue (Japanese only) where Side Toast text appeared broken during Dorothy’s assist in the first argument with Amelia.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3][b]Quest & Translation[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where quest messages were not translated when saved in a different language.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a mistake in the diary where Ernest was incorrectly labeled as “Amelia’s son.”[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue (Japanese only) where Higgins’ name extended beyond the UI bounds.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue (Japanese only) where text appeared broken in Dorothy’s assist section.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the diary could not be opened during the transcription segment.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Improvements in the Yoram Demo
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, this is Team Yoram.[/p][p]We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by the frequent bugs in the demo that made normal gameplay impossible.[/p][p]Below is a list of bugs that have been fixed as of [b]June 12 at 1:00 AM[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where progression was blocked during the first free movement phase[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed untranslated messages in some TIP and Tutorial sections[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some English text in the evidence diary overflowed outside the window[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed character sprite display issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where messages were cut off in certain "Note-taking" situations[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed UI displaying incorrectly under specific conditions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where saving/loading became unavailable in the latter half of the game[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Japanese-specific fixes[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed a font rendering issue in the "Note-taking" feature[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced fonts to improve readability[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected honorific inconsistencies for some characters[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several translation errors[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Known but Unresolved Bugs[/b][/p][list][*][p]A bug where pressing ESC to close the notebook (diary) during a debate makes it impossible to proceed.[/p][/*][*][p]A bug where entering the answer phase without jotting down any statements during "Note-taking" in a debate results in a soft lock.[/p][p][/p][p]We are aware of these two issues, and they are scheduled to be patched in the near future.
For those currently playing the demo, we kindly ask you [b]not to press ESC during debates[/b] to avoid progression issues.
[/p][/*][/list][p]We will do our best to deliver a polished and stable game without bugs in the official release version.
Of course, we will not give up on improving the current demo either — Team Yoram will continue to refine and enhance it going forward.[/p]
